name: Z, the Commons' tontine language, under the whole constitution -- the refusals Z met on its way (ZC5)
comment: Written BEFORE z_v26.haro and before any court change (the W discipline). Every source is Z's own declaration reduced to the kinds the case needs: the rejects are the six articles' refusals as Z itself met them when it was first declared under the constitution -- a refusal without a CODE, a constraint without one, no REFINE, a kind the voice of TELLS reaches nowhere, a landing zone nobody holds, a holder typed as a flow, a movement typed as a format, a holder that may be silent, a rule a model may refine, a point without a floor. The accepts are Z whole under the six articles and both weaves, Z under explainability alone with its voice of TELLS, and Z with the weaves at governance and no PERSONAL seat (nothing to govern at this altitude: a tontine's personal datum is a FIELD of an ENTITY, HF-130). v0.26 adds no clause to the grammar: the rung is the proof on a real world.

accepts.name: Z whole under the six articles and both weaves constitutional: its refusals and constraint coded, a REFINE with every point floored and no rule floored llm, a voice that SAYS every kind and TELLS the question, a landing zone held by a MENU of organizations and entered through a flow, the regime Niger Law 2017-28
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.26", GRAMMAR "0.26", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, not, cmp, contains, add, sub, mul, div, round, neg], OPERANDS [number, text, flag, ref, agg], AGGREGATES [sum, count], ABSENT missing, DIVISION calm, EQUALITY value) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU actors AS (WORDS [collector, treasurer, system, member, auditor]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU outcomes AS (WORDS [commit_to_bedrock, hold]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU formats AS (WORDS [json, csv]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU holders AS (WORDS [the_commons, the_cooperative, the_bank]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM field AS (SEATS [name: name, type: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION enum AS (VERB "ENUM", SEATS [words: [word]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION entity AS (VERB "ENTITY", SEATS [fields: [field]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION norm AS (VERB "NORM", SEATS [rule: zexpr, message: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [flow: flow, order: number, actor: actors, validate: zexpr?, enforcing: norm?, compute: name?, formula: zexpr?, on_fail: text?, on_success: outcomes?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION landing_zone AS (VERB "LANDING_ZONE", SEATS [format: formats, into: flow, held_by: holders]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WALK flows AS (OF flow, STEPS step, THROUGH flow, ORDER order, GUARDS [validate, enforcing.rule], COMPUTE compute, FORMULA formula, FAIL on_fail) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE ASK questions AS (FROM [flow], WHERE zexpr, CLAUSES [where, order, limit]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD z AS (PUBLISH [flow: flow, entity: entity, norm: norm, landing_zone: zone]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_rank_per_flow AS (ON step, WHEN "earlier step where flow = this.flow and order = this.order", MESSAGE "STEP {name} and STEP {other} both stand at ORDER {order} of {flow}: one rank, one step", CODE "ONE_RANK") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The ZQL verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE z AS (POINTS [norm.rule: policy, norm.message: field, step.actor: policy, landing_zone.format: knob, landing_zone.held_by: policy], FLOOR [norm.rule: trusted, norm.message: llm, step.actor: trusted, landing_zone.format: external, landing_zone.held_by: trusted]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE telling AS (SAYS [enum: "{name} is one of {words}.", entity: "{name} is a record of {fields}.", norm: "{name} holds {rule}.", flow: "{name} is a flow.", step: "{name} is step {order} of {flow}.", landing_zone: "{name} is held by {held_by}."], TELLS [ask: "Asking {from}: {question}", answer: "The answer is {count} row(s): {rows}"], REFUSES "I stopped: {message} ({code})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION z_charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability, reversibility, visible_state, predictable_authority, organizational_sovereignty, trust_hierarchy], ZONE landing_zone, SOVEREIGN held_by, MOVEMENT into, WEAVES [sovereignty: constitutional, privacy: constitutional], REGIME niger_2017_28) RATIONALE "the Commons' tontine under the whole constitution"
